description:
Welcome back to The Download. This week, we cover France's massive move to migrate its government ministries to Linux for digital sovereignty. We also look at Canonical's push for local AI inference in Ubuntu and the impressive cost cuts in the new DeepSeek v4 release. Plus, we explore TanStack AI's new framework-agnostic toolkit and bid farewell to Intel 486 support in the Linux kernel. Let us know which update caught your eye in the comments! 

#TheDownload #Linux #Deepseek

— CHAPTERS —  

00:00 Welcome to the Download 
00:33 France migrates to Linux 
01:24 Ubuntu plans local inference 
02:16 DeepSeek v4 lowers costs 
03:26 TanStack AI toolkit alpha 
04:34 Linux drops Intel 486 support 
05:42 Outro
